pairs.evidence: src/lib/materials/surface-spec.ts:137 Generate is blocked for tessellation plus parallax, but the reason calls that pair wasted cost and the shader-budget bar still shows a summed sampler and instruction total.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/content/materials/MaterialBudgetBar.tsx:47 The bar warns at the soft cap and errors above SAMPLER_HARD_LIMIT. The estimator's soft-cap text reserves shared MSAA/UI samplers; the hard-cap path does not block Generate, and this feature set cannot reach 16.

src/lib/material-cost-estimator.ts:123 Glossary constants.ts:62 assigns Occlusion, Roughness, Metallic to R, G, B, and surface-spec.ts:50 says RoughMetalAO. No single layout and no linear tag. StyleTransferTab's prompt also asks for a separate Roughness map.

src/lib/prompts/style-transfer.ts:10 StyleTransferTab sends this table. SURFACE_SPEC glass is ThinTranslucent, and cloth and foliage are forced single models, so the costed path and the generated path can disagree.
src/lib/material-cost-estimator.ts:78 cheaperSwap is its own field and the bar renders it beside the warning, but none of the strings name the look the swap gives up.
src/lib/material-cost-estimator.ts:146 The pair is appended to a report that already summed samplers and instructions. The message frames the canonical depth pair as cost, not as depth applied twice.

src/components/modules/content/materials/MaterialParameterConfigurator/index.tsx:249 This surface budgets samplers and instructions. Searched the materials module for lighting-presets, Lumen, targetTier, and rayTracing; it does not import the GI preset table.

pairs.registryProposal: The node application treats the repo's cheaperSwap strings as this technique realized, but procedure step 4 requires each swap to name the look it gives up, and those strings do not. Reconcile the example with the procedure.
